meta.semantics: consumer-side EAX usage heuristic: linear straight-line block after each call site in full_export disasm snapshot; block truncated at label/jump/ret/second-call. ARITH first-class uses (add/sub/adc/sbb/imul/and/or/xor/shl/shr/cmp/test/cdq on the carrier; partial-reg reads of carrier like test al,al included; self-zero xor r,r / sub r,r excluded) => int signal. PTR uses ([carrier...] deref, lea reg,[carrier..] address-through-carrier, mov ecx,carrier+call thiscall form, push carrier+call ALWAYS counted ptr -- conservative) => ptr signal. mov [slot],carrier STORE neutral. alias propagation mov reg,eax one level (ebx/edx/esi/edi; ecx is this-channel, esp/ebp excluded). per-insn ptr dominates int.
meta.threshold: EAX ent: int_sig>=2 and ptr_sig==0 -> {int,unsigned int}; RET:callee: ptr_sig==0 at all sites and total int_sig>=2
